verdict.rationale: Munito AI is an open-model inference provider, so embeddings and reranking are a fair question to ask of it. Its documented API surface covers only Chat Completions, Responses, speech to text and Anthropic Messages, with no embeddings or rerank endpoint. A RAG recipe and LangChain/LlamaIndex integrations are listed, but neither shows that Munito itself generates embeddings or reranks results.

support.subject: As a developer, I can generate embeddings (and rerank results) for retrieval pipelines without a second vendor
